meta.title: Add LittleEndian methods and optimize BigEndian performance in Extensions.cs
meta.body_summary: Add LittleEndian TryRead methods and replace Math.Pow/division loops with bit shifts for BigEndian in SuperSocket ProtoBase Extensions, claiming 10-100x faster uint/ulong reading.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added LittleEndian methods and optimized bit shifts; maintainer caught unintended global.json change; merged after revert with no performance benchmark requirement.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 235 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume, concentrated in two primary files plus a minor config revert. It fits a small-step performance improvement PR and was merged after a quick review fix.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer kerryjiang noticed global.json was modified to change SDK version; requested revert to keep dotnet SDK 9.0.0. Copilot promptly reverted in follow-up commit.
review_details.performance_claim: 10-100x faster uint/ulong reading via bit shifts instead of Math.Pow and division loops, plus LittleEndian support.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Low-level C# bit-shift optimization and endianness extension required no benchmark proof; merge depended only on reverting an unintended config change.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer kerryjiang manually reviewed the diff and identified an unintended change to global.json that downgraded the SDK version.
detection_detail.ci_auto: No CI performance evidence captured in dataset.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after timing data or profiler output; performance claim is narrative-based with unit tests verifying correctness only.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After review comment, Copilot reverted global.json to keep SDK 9.0.0; no other regressions.

core_change_summary.description: In src/SuperSocket.ProtoBase/Extensions.cs, added TryReadLittleEndian methods for ushort/uint/ulong and replaced Math.Pow+division loops in BigEndian methods with direct bit shifts (e.g., value = (uint)((b0 << 24) | (b1 << 16) | (b2 << 8) | b3)). Added corresponding tests in test/SuperSocket.Tests/SequenceReaderExtensionTest.cs.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: global.json was inadvertently modified to SDK 8.0.117; corrected back to 9.0.0 after review.
change_trajectory: Initial plan and implementation commits add LittleEndian methods and optimize BigEndian with bit shifts.
Review feedback: maintainer requested revert of global.json SDK version change.
Final commit reverts global.json; PR merged.

review_signals.summary: Noted that global.json should keep dotnet SDK 9.0.0 instead of the changed version.
Requested Copilot to revert the global.json change.
Confirmed revert of global.json to keep SDK 9.0.0.
Approved PR after revert and no further issues.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with performance optimization and tests.
Maintainer kerryjiang spotted unintended global.json SDK version change and requested revert.
Copilot promptly reverted and PR was approved and merged within ~4 hours.
